convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, and no external dependencies. Standard MT5 EA pattern with straightforward logic.

other_exits: Signal reversal closes opposite position before opening new one - implicit in position gate check

custom_logic_notes: Classic two-MA crossover EA. The EA uses IsNewBar pattern to evaluate crossover only once per bar using bar[1] and bar[2] values (previous completed bar and the one before), avoiding intrabar repainting. When a reverse signal occurs, the existing position is closed and a new opposite position is opened on the same bar. SL/TP values are specified in points and applied via CTrade.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas EWM for EMA calculation. Crossover detection via comparison of EMA[1] vs EMA[2] on completed bars only (shift by 1). Implement new-bar guard using bar timestamp tracking. SL/TP in pips need conversion to price offset (multiply by pip_size). Position check before entry: close existing opposite position first if signal reverses. No digit adjustment needed since Python operates in price space directly.
